svg.title: \mathbf{y} = \begin{pmatrix} v_{L+1} \\ v_{L+2} \\ v_{L+3} \\ \vdots \\ v_T \end{pmatrix} \qquad \mathbf{M} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & v_L & v_{L-1} & \cdots & v_1 \\ 1 & v_{L+1} & v_L & \cdots & v_2 \\ 1 & v_{L+2} & v_{L+1} & \cdots & v_3 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ 1 & v_{T-1} & v_{T-2} & \cdots & v_{T-L} \end{pmatrix}.
